title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: AL Object Relations Visualizer (New VS Code extension)
summary: The AL Object Relations Visualizer is a VS Code extension that creates interactive, force-directed graph visualizations of relationships between AL objects in Business Central projects. It helps developers understand code dependencies through color-coded nodes, clickable file navigation, and detailed tooltips showing field names, variable declarations, and relation types.
key_points: Provides force-directed graph visualization using D3.js to display AL object relationships
Automatically scans workspace to find all AL objects and their dependencies
Offers detailed tooltips with contextual information about field names, variables, and source tables
Enables direct file opening by clicking nodes and color-codes objects by type for quick identification

quotes.text: AL Object Relations Visualizer: Visualizes relationships between AL objects in Business Central projects
